presets.label: Low
presets.description: RTX 2060-3060 / 4060, AMD and Intel with RT. No hardware scene build, no Ray Reconstruction: screen-space GI and contact shadows.

presets.label: Medium
presets.description: RTX 3070/3080, 4060 Ti/4070. Opaque ray-traced geometry, RT GI, fast local-light shadows, glossy reflections.

presets.label: High
presets.description: RTX 4080/4090, 5080. Everything ray traced at the developer defaults (today's bg3rtx.ini).

presets.label: Ultra (RTX 5090)
presets.description: RTX 5090 at 4K-class output. High plus 2 GI rays, shadowed lights, rougher reflections and a 58 fps rendered cap (116 displayed with frame generation 2x).

knobs.label: Ray Reconstruction
knobs.description: DLSS Ray Reconstruction replaces the game's DLSS upscaler and denoises the ray-traced effects. Needs an NVIDIA RTX GPU and the game's upscaler set to DLSS. Off: DLSS Super Resolution, and the effects switch to their non-denoised paths. About +1.8 ms on an RTX 5090.

knobs.label: Ray-traced geometry
knobs.description: Builds the game's geometry into a ray-tracing scene every frame. Every ray-traced effect below needs it. Static meshes are built once and cached, so the update costs about 0.5 ms on an RTX 5090, panning or not (it was 1.4-2.9 ms while the camera moved). Opaque leaves alpha-tested casters (grates, foliage, chains) out. Off frees that cost and the geometry capture.

knobs.label: Sun shadows
knobs.description: Ray-traced sun shadows replace the game's shadow-map detail; screen-space keeps the game's sun shadows with contact shadows. About 0.1 ms.

knobs.label: Roof sun shadows
knobs.description: Captures the roofs the camera cuts away (from the game's sun shadow map) into the ray-traced scene, so ray-traced sun shadows also work under them. On in Ultra since 2026-10-31: physically correct, no regression in the camp and inn gates, about +0.3 to +1.3 ms.

knobs.label: Global illumination
knobs.description: One bounce of indirect light and ambient occlusion. Screen-space traces the depth buffer; ray-traced traces the scene. RT High uses 2 rays per pixel (less noise in dim interiors, about +0.2 ms).

knobs.label: Local light shadows
knobs.description: Ray-traced shadows for torches, lamps and spells, so lights without a shadow map stop leaking through walls. Fast samples 1 light per pixel (noisier, needs Ray Reconstruction). Full also traces the lights that have a game shadow map, keeping the game's map only where a caster may be off screen. Full+ replaces those maps everywhere (off-screen casters can be lost). About 0.2-0.4 ms.

knobs.label: Box light shadows
knobs.description: Ray-traced shadows for the game's box (projector) lights, 37% of its placed lights. Look at lit interiors: shadows of furniture and characters from these lights. About +0.25 ms. Off in every preset until the live box-light check passes. "All" also shadows the ones the game leaves unshadowed (they light through walls now): look for light leaking into the next room, and check that the main-menu skull keeps its beam.

knobs.label: Reflections
knobs.description: Ray-traced reflections replace the game's reflection probes where the reflected point is on screen. Higher settings reach rougher surfaces. Without Ray Reconstruction only mirror-like surfaces are traced. About 0.15-0.45 ms.

knobs.label: Frame generation
knobs.description: DLSS Frame Generation: 2x on RTX 40 and later, 3x/4x on RTX 50. Needs Reflex.

knobs.label: RT lighting intensity
knobs.description: Scales the ray-traced bounce light, local-light shadows and reflections together. 100% is physically matched to the game; lower blends towards the original look.

knobs.label: Frame cap (rendered fps)
knobs.description: Caps the rendered frame rate (with frame generation 2x the display shows twice as many). Through the Reflex limiter when frame generation is on, a sleep limiter otherwise.

knobs.label: NVIDIA Reflex
knobs.description: Low-latency mode. Frame generation needs it on.

knobs.label: RT water
knobs.description: Ray-traced water. Reflections: the docks, piers and boats reflected in the water where the reflected point is on screen, with the water's own Fresnel, opacity and fog (about 0.1 ms; the game's probe elsewhere). + Shadows: ray-traced sun and local-light shadows on the water, and the game's own sun shadow on the few water surfaces that have one (the camp's pond) replaced by the traced one. + Refraction: the pool or sea bed seen through the bent ray (Snell's law), so it looks shallower and moves with the waves. All levels together about 0.5-0.7 ms (Water Queens House) and up to 520 MB of video memory for the water records. Turning a level on needs a restart (the water shaders are prepared at load); turning it down is live. On in Ultra. Debug views rt_debug 25-28.

knobs.label: Hidden-surface shading
knobs.description: Gives ray hits on surfaces the camera does not see their verified native material (static virtual-texture views, reflectance, tangent frame), including the wind-animated and two-sided foliage rows, with the capture buffers reused (no stale scene). Materials: the material data only. + Bounce: the GI bounce from those hidden surfaces is shaded with point, spot and sun light and traced shadows (never darker; about +0.5 ms with sun). + Reflections: reflection rays that hit them are shaded with that material and lighting, and get the screen's bounce light, instead of keeping the reflection probe (about +1.4 to +1.8 ms). Unsupported materials or lights keep the current renderer. The first enable needs a restart; the levels above Materials are live. + Bounce in Ultra (M4 promotion); + Reflections stays experimental: its quality and GPU cost remain unqualified.

knobs.label: Emission at ray hits
knobs.description: Bounce and reflection rays that hit a glowing surface (lava, braziers, glowing runes) on a hidden surface add that surface's emitted light, from the captured emissive geometry (this setting turns the emissive capture, rt_emissive, on with it). It shows where Hidden-surface shading + Bounce or + Reflections shades the hit. Hidden hits in Ultra (M4 promotion).

knobs.label: Far-field sun bounce
knobs.description: Lengthens the bounce rays from 1 m to 6 m. Surfaces up to that distance that are on screen, or hidden with a verified native material lit by the sun, replace the game's ambient light for their ray. Other surfaces beyond 1 m keep the game's ambient. Needs Hidden-surface shading + Bounce. Experimental: the live energy check (-0.3% exposure-normalised) disagrees in size with the reference, so it stays off.

knobs.label: Native coverage
knobs.description: Uses the game's own coverage for ray queries where the audit verified it. Hair + scalp: the CHAR_Hair strand coverage and depth, and the scalp coverage (other hair families remain gaps). + Tilesets: also the instanced floor and wall coverage (SeeThrough and missing native inputs remain unknown). Needs Full ray-traced geometry. Restart required (the captured vertex layout changes). Experimental: quality and GPU cost are unqualified.

knobs.label: Physical hair ray origins (advanced)
knobs.description: Starts secondary rays on the selected native hair card while retaining native camera depth for primary checks. Enable at startup with Native coverage to reserve the auxiliary image; then Off/On is a live A/B. Starting Off requires a restart before enabling. Quality and GPU cost remain unqualified.
knobs.apply_note: Enable at startup; then live A/B

knobs.label: Opacity micromaps
knobs.description: Experimental hardware opacity micromaps for the audited static alpha-material subset. Requires Full ray-traced geometry, Vulkan 1.3, EXT opacity micromaps, buffer device address, timeline semaphores, synchronization2 and the static BVH split. Unsupported or stale inputs use the reference scene. Useful in-game coverage and speed are not qualified. Restart required to negotiate device features.

knobs.label: Preserve cutout capture on overflow
knobs.description: Uses free space in the existing capture buffer when its cutout partition fills. Retains native coverage and hair geometry for exact split draws. Does not increase memory limits or fix missing material inputs. Experimental until the capacity gates hold (0 drops); then it becomes automatic.

knobs.label: Experimental lighting reference
knobs.description: Shows a limited reference using point and spot lights on supported opaque surfaces. Two surfaces adds one indirect bounce; incomplete paths retain direct-only lighting and are counted. Requires Hidden-surface shading at startup. No sunlight, sky, emission or full-scene quality claim. This replaces the display for inspection; it is not a gameplay quality preset.

knobs.label: Local light sampling (exact-k)
knobs.description: Cost option for interiors with many lights: the strongest 1 or 2 lights of each pixel keep their own shadow ray, and one ray is shared by the rest, picked in proportion to their light and weighted so the mean brightness is unchanged. Needs Local light shadows Full. Off by user decision (developer only).

knobs.label: Current cascade sun shadows
knobs.description: Uses the current four native sun-caster domains with finite per-layer rays and native receiver selection. Needs ray-traced geometry, Roof sun shadows, RT device setup and the static BVH split. Gives one window of samples, then falls back while the scene is unready (DIALOGUE_SHADOWS.md): developer only until fixed. Restart required.
